original.target_description: Verified Mellers, Hertwig, and Kahneman (2001). Experiment 1, printed p. 272 (PDF p. 4), Table 2, reports both Linda and James frequency-estimate comparisons of the "and" conjunction versus the unlikely target. The supplied description and locator do not identify which personality scenario is assigned.

replication.target_description: Verified Chandrashekar et al. (2021), published journal version. Printed p. 3, Table 2, separately reports Linda Story and James Story "and" and Unlikely target comparisons; results are also described on p. 6. The supplied description and study identifier do not distinguish these two tests.

reported_success.quote: Linda story can be concluded as a successful replication. James replication is a likely failed replication.

notes: Both full primary papers were acquired and their titles verified. No personality scenario was specified in the assigned input; both Linda and James match the given comparison and page locators, and they have different results and narrative verdicts. No single scenario was selected from table order. Value fields remain null because target identity cannot be established. Original Experiment 1 reports only an average of 108 participants per group on p. 272, not an exact analytic n for either target comparison, and does not print Cohen's d. The original-results d column of the replication Table 2 is explicitly a mini-meta-analysis across original Experiments 1, 2, and 3 and must not be substituted for assigned original Study 1. Replication p. 4 states four responses met exclusion criteria but the main report retains the full sample; hence older excluded-sample versions should not be merged with the published Table 2.
